subject: Authorization request: two runtime/platform engineers for capacity optimization
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Authorization request: two runtime/platform engineers for capacity optimization

Team —

Requesting formal approval to open two full-time headcount slots on the Runtime team:

1) Senior Runtime Engineer (L5/L6 target) — primary focus: inference serving optimizations, kernel-level performance work, KV cache improvements.
2) Platform Engineer (L4/L5 target) — primary focus: autoscaling policies, routing, and capacity tooling for Dedicated pools.

Rationale: over the last three quarters weve observed sustained growth in Dedicated workload (peak tokens up ~2.3x) and an uptick in tail latency events when burst capacity is triggered. These two hires unlock a two-pronged approach: reduce per-token cost via smarter batching + kernel tuning (senior role) and improve autoscale/recovery and routing policies (platform role).

Timing / ask: approval to post requisitions and engage recruiters this week; target offers in Jan 2027, start by Mar/Apr 2027.

Budget ask (high level):
- Headcount: 2 FTEs
- Estimated FY27 run-rate delta: $420k-$520k fully burdened (depends on level and equity)
- Comp bands attached (comp-band-2026-Q4.pdf) and a quick budget workbook attached (headcount-request-20261103.xlsx).

Key constraints / notes:
- Prefer US-based candidates but open to EU for Platform role if cost profile helps.
- For the Senior Runtime role, were targeting engineers with production inference runtime experience (quantization/latency optimizations) rather than general backend.
- We will reuse the current interview loop used for infra hires (1 screen, 2 tech interviews, 1 system design, hiring manager debrief).

Requesting: Laura — headcount approval; Marcus — budget confirmation and guidance on band levels/total cost to company; Lauren — coordination with Talent/Recruiting if approved.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Runtime & Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: two runtime/platform engineers for capacity optimization

On Wed, Nov 3, 2026 at 10:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Requesting formal approval to open two full-time headcount slots on the Runtime team...

Thanks for the summary, Vivek. Im supportive of the ask in principle — these are clearly high-leverage hires given our Dedicated growth. A couple of asks before I sign off:

- Please tighten the suggested comp ranges for each role to the explicit bands weve been using for Q4 (I need line items for base, bonus, and equity as separate numbers).
- Provide an interview loop + hiring manager scorecard we will use; where will the hiring funnel live (Lever/Greenhouse)?
- If were targeting Jan offers, confirm Talent has capacity — copying Lauren to coordinate.

Assuming you supply the above and Marcus confirms the burdened run-rate, Ill approve a headcount allocation and well convert to an active req.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: two runtime/platform engineers for capacity optimization

Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the context. I reviewed the attached workbook and comp band PDF. A few clarifying questions before I can lock the budget:

1) Level confirmation: which role are you expecting to land as L6 vs L5? The delta changes the burdened cost materially.
2) Geography: confirm if both hires will be US-remote (we will assume SF-based burden for conservative calc) or if youre open to hiring in lower-cost regions.
3) On-Target Equity: please provide the equity grant assumptions (RSU % or options, cliff/vesting) you expect to grant at offer.

Action: if you can provide updated numbers by EOD Monday Ill run the FY27 run-rate and confirm we can absorb ~ $480k within the current headcount plan. If we need to move beyond that, Ill escalate to finance leadership but prefer to avoid a separate request.

Attaching the comp-band-2026-Q4.pdf that contains the canonical bands.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance — GTM & Engineering Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:48:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Authorization request: two runtime/platform engineers for capacity optimization

Marcus / Laura —

Thanks for the fast follow. Answers inline below and Ive attached an updated workbook (headcount-request-20261120.xlsx) to the Drive link (see related_links).

1) Leveling: Senior Runtime = L6 (strong IC hire) ; Platform Engineer = L5.
2) Geography: plan A is US-remote for both. If we need cost relief well widen to EU for Platform role only.
3) Equity assumptions: Senior Runtime (L6) = target ~0.35% RSU over 4 years (annualized grant at hire ~0.0875%); Platform (L5) = target ~0.12% RSU over 4 years. I called out sign-on bridge expectations in the workbook.

Next steps I will execute:
- Update the posting with explicit base/bonus/equity line items and share the final offer bands to Marcus by tomorrow morning.
- Loop Talent and NimbleCloud recruiter (external) to start outreach if we have approval.
- Draft the interview loop and hiring scorecard and attach to the Drive folder.

Requesting Laura: please confirm headcount approval when youre comfortable (Ill convert to an active req and queue with Talent). Marcus: please confirm the run-rate fits within the current plan (your corridor of ~$480k sounded acceptable).

If either of you wants to chat live Im available for a 20m sync this week.

Cheers —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Runtime & Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachments: headcount-request-20261120.xlsx
